title: A digital-twin framework for forecasting treatment-day imaging with contour uncertainty in adaptive proton radiotherapy
abstract: arXiv:2609.24725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Head-and-neck anatomy changes over a six-to-seven-week proton course, and the anatomy of a later week cannot be imaged when the plan is made. We present a digital-twin framework that forecasts a patient's treatment-day anatomy as an ensemble of predicted CTs with propagated contours and quantifies the uncertainty of the forecast contours. The twin is a library of previously treated patients with planning and weekly quality-assurance CTs (QACTs), made patient-specific by a two-step foundation-model deformable registration: a cross-patient field carries each library patient onto the current patient, and a longitudinal field, estimated in the current patient's frame, carries that patient's planning-to-QACT change onto the current patient's own planning CT. translated_title: 一种用于自适应质子放疗中预测治疗日影像及轮廓不确定性的数字孪生框架
translated_abstract: 在为期六至七周的质子治疗疗程中，头颈部解剖结构会发生变化，而在制定治疗计划时无法对后续几周的解剖结构进行成像。我们提出了一种数字孪生框架，该框架将患者治疗日的解剖结构预测为一组带有传播轮廓的预测CT集合，并量化预测轮廓的不确定性。该数字孪生是一个由既往治疗患者组成的数据库，包含其计划CT和每周质量保证CT（QACT），通过两步基础模型形变配准实现患者特异性：跨患者形变场将数据库中每位患者映射到当前患者身上，而在当前患者坐标系中估计的纵向形变场则将该数据库患者的“计划CT到QACT”变化应用于当前患者自身的计划CT。来自88名患者的302个观测数据构成的数据库可为每位患者生成约300个重复样本，每个样本都是真实治疗患者中发生过的形变。传播轮廓的离散程度……
tldr: 提出一种基于基础模型两步形变配准的数字孪生框架，利用既往患者影像数据库预测质子放疗患者治疗日的CT影像及轮廓集合，并量化轮廓预测的不确定性，以辅助自适应放疗计划决策。
en_tdlr: A digital-twin framework leverages a library of previously treated patients and two-step foundation-model deformable registration to forecast treatment-day CTs with propagated contours and quantify contour uncertainty for adaptive proton radiotherapy.
